evidence: The official SDC3a page describes a 7.5 TB visibility measurement set, image cubes, beam/layout/noise ancillary products, test data and revealed EoR truth/power spectra. The challenge data are simulated/synthetic SKA-Low products.
LFW comprises 13,233 labeled face images of 5,749 people collected from the web and provides benchmark pair/split protocols for unconstrained recognition and verification.

The official page distributes CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 labeled image archives. CIFAR-10 contains 60,000 32x32 colour images in 10 classes with a 50,000/10,000 train/test split; CIFAR-100 uses the same image count with fine/coarse labels.
